description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateNoteButton class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate, used for rendering the 'Create Note' button in a subpanel of the SuiteCRM interface. It includes methods to generate HTML forms for creating notes associated with other records, handling form field preparation, and access control checks.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateNoteButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering the 'Create Note' button in subpanels, providing form generation and display functionalities for creating notes linked to other records within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML form string for creating a new Note, populated with relevant hidden fields based on provided definitions and additional form fields. Includes access control checks and dynamic form field population.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the 'Create Note' button if the current user has edit access, by calling the parent display method.
